reviewed_sources.title: Hairy binary black holes in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory and their effective-one-body description
reviewed_sources.read_scope: PDF pages 7-8: section III.A, (3.1)-(3.7); pages 23-26: complete appendix A, (A1)-(A37), including action, field solutions, on-shell action and final integration. Page 9 and conclusion pages 22-23 also inspected.
reviewed_sources.adopted: Zero-dilaton conservative nonspinning 1PN two-body Lagrangian (3.1)/(A37), in harmonic coordinates. G=c=1 geometric charges, followed by common electromagnetic duality.
reviewed_sources.independent_checks: Static extremal cancellation; exact RN test-particle action; circular radial variation and independent Cartesian variation before circular substitution.
reviewed_sources.limitation: This is an adopted established 1PN action, not a new independent derivation of every field term. Upstream PN regularization proofs and the rest of the paper are not completely audited; no uniform PN remainder or wormhole applicability theorem is imported.

reviewed_sources.title: Inspiraling binary charged black holes in an external magnetic field
reviewed_sources.read_scope: HTML abstract, introduction, sections 2.1-2.3; PDF pages 4-5, equations (8)-(17). Visually inspected rendered PDF page 4 to check the sign in (11). Reference list checked for 1PN predecessors. Later sections not fully reviewed.
reviewed_sources.rejected: Equation (11) prints -G Q1 Q2(m1+m2)/r^2. This fails both exact same-sign extremal static cancellation and the RN test-body limit. The positive sign in Khalil et al. passes both.
reviewed_sources.current_version_check: arXiv submission history reports v2 dated 2026-02-02; published 2026-02-28. Publisher HTML equation (11) also displays the negative sign when read 2026-10-11.
reviewed_sources.limitation: No claim that every result in the paper is affected. External uniform-field approximation and its omission of field gravitational response are not imported into the RN mouth calculation. No author contact or correction submission made.

reviewed_sources.title: The motion of point particles in curved spacetime
reviewed_sources.read_scope: PDF pages 47-49, sections 9.2-9.5: FW tetrad, Fermi coordinate construction, coordinate displacements, and metric (9.14)-(9.16). Page 50 and section 9.6 read for context.
reviewed_sources.adopted: Accelerated Fermi metric Taylor expansion in a regular external background.
reviewed_sources.limitation: Normal-neighborhood and smoothness hypotheses remain. No uniform bound across a strong RN self-field or full quantum-open junction, and no complete review of bitensor dependencies or self-force chapters.

reviewed_sources.title: Accelerated Charges
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Entire lecture subsection, retarded potentials and chain rule through acceleration/velocity fields, equations (1889)-(1920). HTML alt text truncates some long displays; the surrounding derivation and separately differentiated potentials are used to check the complete field expression.
reviewed_sources.adopted: Lienard-Wiechert potentials and retarded derivatives, followed by electromagnetic duality and the Lorentz boost.
reviewed_sources.independent_checks: Direct fourth-order finite differentiation of the retarded potentials at displaced spacetime points; refinement, light-cone roots, Lorentz invariants and symbolic circular series.
reviewed_sources.limitation: Flat prescribed circular worldline only, not the full Einstein-Maxwell binary solution.

metadata_only_leads.title: EFT approach to general relativity: correction to EIH Lagrangian due to electromagnetic charge

contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping and matched finite-duration band transfer. Leading circular-binary magnetic and motional electric mouth data are derived in a controlled leading-order model, with independently checked flat retarded fields and established conservative 1PN orbital coefficients. Local proper and coordinate orbital accelerations are distinguished. The electric/axial response, smooth quantum-open junction, transported frames, holonomy and semiclassical state remain unresolved. These classical ingredients are prior work; no consequential novelty is accepted.
next_decisive_question: Solve the stationary electric/axial dipole and remaining multipoles through a smooth quantum-open junction; derive transported frames and physical return holonomy, then control the time-dependent quantum state and renormalized source/exterior response.
